subject: ODBC to Oracle - “negative length vectors are not allowed”

messages.author: b555f01b0716fd66
messages.subject: ODBC to Oracle - “negative length vectors are not allowed”
parts:
I’m currently trying to connect Rattle to my Oracle DB via the ODBC connection. With Oracle if I don’t set the ‘believeNRows=FALSE’ parameter in my odbcConnect command then I have the issue of “negative length vectors are not allowed”

I expected that the “believe num rows” checkbox in Rattle would avoid the negative length vectors by setting this parameter however the command that’s being issued is:

crs$odbc <- odbcConnect("DWH")

When I check the box I get the same command. Is this an error or do you have any other suggestions?

I’m using Rattle version 2.6.15 and R version 2.14.0

Thanks-
Andy

 

Analytics Manager

Shutterfly, Inc.

messages.subject: Re: ODBC to Oracle - “negative length vectors are not allowed”
parts:
That looks like a bug. I'll fix it for next release.

In the meantime, run the correct commands from the R Console, through copy and paste from the Rattle Log and fix the odbc call. Except, read the data into "ds" rather than crs$dataset. Then in Rattle load R Dataset and choose "ds" to load.

Regards,
Graham
